capture_method: Every value below was copied from a JSON response or official page returned by the fetch tool on 2026-11-20. The exact response time is not returned by the tool. Kalshi values are live and can change; re-check the linked URL before relying on a value.
sandbox_limit: The build sandbox cannot reach Kalshi or EIA directly (outbound allow-list only). Values were collected through the page-fetch tool, so this is a sample, not a full dump of every Kalshi market.

flags.subject: DIESEL, DIESELM
flags.issue: Queried for open markets (DIESEL, status=open) and for any status (DIESELM); both returned an empty markets list. No Kalshi price was captured for either series.

flags.subject: DIESEL settlement source
flags.issue: The API lists the EIA spot table (PET_PRI_SPT_S1_D). The DIESEL contract terms say the underlying is 'Diesel (On Highway) - All Types' from EIA's Weekly Retail Gasoline and Diesel Prices table (PET_PRI_GND_DCUS_NUS_W). The two EIA tables are different. Needs manual confirmation against the official contract terms.

flags.subject: Gasoline coverage
flags.issue: Querying series by tag Gas returned only two series (both diesel). No Kalshi retail gasoline series was found by this query. The check was tag-based and may miss series with other tags.

flags.subject: EIA area coverage
flags.issue: The EIA retail table was captured for the default U.S. area. California and San Francisco prices were not captured, so local gas prices are not in this snapshot.

flags.subject: KXSNAPELECTION
flags.issue: The series title reads 'fdajkladfsjklasdfjkl;adfsljk;afds', which looks like placeholder or test text in the production API. Its settlement sources are a generic list. Not a real-world event title. Excluded from analysis.

flags.subject: KXSENATELAR
flags.issue: The series title is only 'LAR', so the event being priced is not stated in the title. The contract must be read to know what it is. Not interpreted here.

flags.subject: KXXBANNEDGROK
flags.issue: The series is listed, but a markets query returned an empty list. No price was captured.

flags.subject: KXXBANNEDMURRAYHILLGUY1, KXXBANNEDGROK
flags.issue: Settlement sources include the placeholder text 'account holder of ', Google search URLs (for example, 'Ars Technica' and 'Engadget'), and Elon Musk's X profile. Several entries are not publisher home pages. Not an official resolution source.

flags.subject: KXBTCMAX100-26-NOV (and the series)
flags.issue: Both open Bitcoin $100k markets captured (KXBTCMAX100-26-NOV and -DEC) show updated_time 2026-09-08 while status is 'active'. The data may be stale. Compare against the live endpoint before relying on it.

flags.subject: KXAIRDROPHYPE
flags.issue: The settlement list names 'CoinTelegraph' but links to https://bitchat.free/, which does not match the publisher's name. Verify before use.

flags.subject: KXWAL25
flags.issue: Title says 2025, but it is in the 2026 data set with last_updated_ts 2026-10-15. Status and relevance should be confirmed.

flags.subject: KXFDVFOOTBALLFUN
flags.issue: Title 'Football Fun' does not say what is measured, and the series sits in the Crypto category with a CoinGecko settlement source. Contract terms should be read before classifying it.

flags.subject: KXPGA3BALL 2nd-round markets
flags.issue: All three captured markets show volume 0, open interest 0, and last_price 0.0000, but a non-zero two-sided quote (for example bid 0.34 / ask 0.37). The quote has not traded. Treat the price as a quote, not a traded price.

flags.subject: KXDPWORLDTOUR
flags.issue: The series is listed, but an open-markets query returned an empty list.

flags.subject: KXBRYSONCOURSERECORDS
flags.issue: The only settlement source is a YouTube channel named after a participant (DeChambeau's own channel). This is not an independent source, so the resolution process should be checked before any use.

flags.subject: Status naming
flags.issue: The get-markets documentation lists status values unopened, open, closed, and settled. Responses in this capture label open markets 'active' and settled markets 'finalized'. The filter names and response values do not match.

flags.subject: Dollar volume
flags.issue: Volume fields are contract counts (volume_fp, volume_24h_fp, open_interest_fp). The market schema in the docs has no dollar-volume field. 'Highest dollar amount' therefore cannot be shown as reported dollars. Rankings here use contract counts.

flags.subject: Live dashboard browser access
flags.issue: The live dashboard reads the public Kalshi API from the visitor's browser. Whether the API accepts browser requests from GitHub Pages (CORS) could not be tested from the build sandbox. Unverified until tested after publish.

flags.subject: Trading and demo portfolio
flags.issue: No demo account credentials or API key were available. The sandbox cannot reach the demo API. No trades were placed, and no portfolio data was pulled. The portfolio, trade log, and strategy sections are blocked until a demo key is supplied.

flags.subject: README and repo hygiene
flags.issue: README.md contained only the title '# KalshiDash2' at the start of this session. No LICENSE, .gitignore, or CI configuration was present in the repository.

flags.subject: GitHub Pages config
flags.issue: GitHub Pages is set to build legacy from branch main, path /. The site is served from the repository root, which is why the site files live there. Verified through the GitHub API.
